title: Flood layers
description: A night of rising water as cause and effect, switched on by a mission step's params.flood_layer (value 'live' keeps the live-weather path: events:mua_ngap). Time t is game hours since the step started. The river gauge (river_m) and the rain (rain_mm_h) come from `timeline`. A zone of cause 'song' is under the river: depth = river_m - floor_m. A zone of cause 'mua' fills with rain and empties through the drains: d(depth)/dt = (rain_mm_h x catchment - drain) / 1000 metres per hour, where drain = drain_mm_h, or drain_mm_h x pump_share while the river stands at or above gravity_block_river_m (the outfalls cannot run into a high river, only the pumps work). Depth is clamped to [0, max_depth_m] and integrated in steps of step_h. A road inside a zone is closed to a vehicle class when the depth reaches passable_depth_m of that class and slowed by slow_speed_factor from slow_depth_m; a motorbike ridden into impassable water stalls (gameplay event xe_chet_may). `closures` are orders (a bridge closed from an hour while the river is high). While any rain zone is deeper than slow_depth_m the layer keeps `world_events` on, so the economy and random events feel the flood. Runtime: UHanoiFloodSubsystem (UE), FloodSystem (Unity core); reference model and golden table: tools/runtime_rules.py.

duration_h.description: Game hours the layer lasts after it starts.

step_h.description: Integration step in game hours (both engines precompute the depth table with it).

name.description: Hydrological station the river level is read at.

alarm_m.description: Báo động 1, 2, 3 in metres at that station.

gravity_block_river_m.description: River level from which the city drains can no longer flow out by gravity.

pump_share.description: Share of drain_mm_h that pumps keep up while gravity is blocked.

timeline.description: Keyframes in t order. river_m is interpolated linearly between keyframes; rain_mm_h holds from its keyframe to the next one. The first keyframe is at t = 0.

cause.description: song = under the river (floor_m); mua = rain that the drains cannot take.

floor_m.description: song: ground level on the gauge's datum, metres.

catchment.description: mua: how many times the rain falling on the zone runs into it from around (a low spot collects its street).

drain_mm_h.description: mua: what the drains take away, in millimetres of depth per hour, with gravity outfalls open.

max_depth_m.description: mua: water spills elsewhere beyond this depth.

coords_source.description: landmark = landmarks.json coordinate; uoc_luong = placed by hand on the street, to check against the map.

radius_m.description: Road graph edges whose midpoint is this close to the landmark are closed.

from_h.description: The order takes effect at this t.

river_m_at_least.description: The order stands while the river is at or above this level.

traffic_rule.description: traffic_rules:<id> broken by riding through the closure.

passable_depth_m.description: Depth from which a vehicle class cannot go through (motorbike: water at the exhaust and air intake).

world_events.description: events:<id> kept on while a rain zone is deeper than slow_depth_m.
